description: This file contains a utility function _annotate_modules_for_dynamo that annotates PyTorch modules for use with Dynamo and FSDP, marking modules as managed and setting attributes to indicate FSDP usage. It is specific to the integration of Torch FSDP with Dynamo for model tracing and graph compilation.

methods.name: None _annotate_modules_for_dynamo( module: nn.Module, ignored_modules: set[nn.Module], use_orig_params: bool, )
methods.description: Annotates submodules within a given module to indicate they are FSDP-managed and sets attributes related to Dynamo and FSDP integration.

ctags.name: _annotate_modules_for_dynamo
ctags.signature: ( module: nn.Module, ignored_modules: set[nn.Module], use_orig_params: bool, )
